title: Alcohol per capita consumption (aged 15 years and older) within a calendar year in litres of pure alcohol
graph_title: Alcohol per capita consumption (aged 15 years and older) within a calendar year in litres of pure alcohol
national_indicator_available: Alcohol per capita consumption (aged 15 years and older) within a calendar year in litres of pure alcohol
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures per capita alcohol consumption among the population aged 15 years and older within a calendar year in litres of pure alcohol
computation_definitions: Total alcohol per capita (15+ years) consumption (APC) is defined as the total (sum of three-year average recorded APC and unrecorded APC adjusted for tourist consumption) amount of pure alcohol consumed per adult (15+ years), in a calendar year, in litres of pure alcohol.
computation_calculations: Total alcohol consumption in a calendar year / Population over 15 years old in that calendar year
other_info: Further information on alcohol consumption in Rwanda is available from the [STEPS Survey](https://www.rbc.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/report23/STEPS%20Booklet.pdf) conducted by the Ministry of Health (MoH).
comments_limitations: For more details on methodology, see the linked data source.
indicator_name: Alcohol per capita consumption (aged 15 years and older) within a calendar year in litres of pure alcohol
target_name: Strengthen the prevention and treatment of substance abuse, including narcotic drug abuse and harmful use of alcohol
indicator_definition: Harmful use of alcohol, defined according to the national context as alcohol per capita consumption (aged 15 years and older) within a calendar year in litres of pure alcohol.
